newsitem.title: IRAN: Khatami sworn in as Iran president.
newsitem.headline: Khatami sworn in as Iran president.

text.p: Iran's new President Mohammad Khatami took the oath of office on Monday vowing to safeguard the country's religion and constitution.

"I as the president of the Islamic Republic of Iran swear before the holy Koran and the Iranian nation and God to be the guardian of the official religion, the Islamic republic and the constitution," Khatami said at the ceremony in parliament.
Khatami, 54, was confirmed as president on Sunday by Iran's spiritual leader, Ayatollah Ali Khamenei, three months after he won a landslide election victory against a conservative foe.
He was expected to announce his cabinet this week. It must be approved by the conservative-dominated parliament.
